style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Pre-Lit Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Illuminate your space with the cosy charm of this artificial 40cm natural feel wreath with lights. This beautifully crafted wreath combines the beauty of lifelike frosted greenery with the warm glow of integrated lights, creating a stunning focal point for your home. With its realistic leaves and elements, this wreath brings the essence of the outdoors inside, adding a touch of beauty to any room. The soft, twinkling lights add a magical ambiance, perfect for both holiday celebrations and year-round decor. Whether hung on your front door, displayed above the mantel, or placed as a centrepiece, this wreath effortlessly blends elegance with festive warmth, creating a welcoming atmosphere wherever it’s placed. Wreath width: D40cm. . 2x AA batteries required. Batteries not included.
